Is anything stealing from this phone?
Checks every app, who has deep control, what can hear or watch you, what runs all the time, and where your data goes. Reads only. Changes nothing until you say so.

This app looks for anything on this phone that could steal from you: known malware, hidden apps, apps with deep control, apps that can read your screen or your messages, apps that run all the time, and where your data goes. It only reads. It never removes or changes anything itself; when you choose to remove an app, Android shows its own confirmation.
Every app is checked against lists stored on this phone (MalwareBazaar, URLhaus, ThreatFox, Exodus Privacy, MVT). Nothing about this phone is sent anywhere.
Usage access (optional): lets the app see which apps ran in the background this week. Android asks you on a Settings screen.
Data flow watch (optional, 10 minutes): a local VPN that notes which names apps look up, then stops. Android asks you with a system dialog. Nothing is redirected or stored beyond the names.
Looking inside apps. The first scan takes a minute or two; later scans are quick.
A 10 minute local watch notes which names each app looks up, then the result is rescanned on its own. Android asks for consent first.
